==== Ontario ====
OpenStreetMap includes data from the [https://data.ontario.ca/ Government Of Ontario.]  Data is provided by the Goverment Of Ontario and is licensed under [https://www.ontario.ca/page/open-government-licence-ontario Open Government Licence – Ontario.]

OpenStreetMap includes data from [https://www.metrolinx.com/en/about-us/open-data Ontario – Metrolinx].  Data is provided by Metrolinx and is licensed under [https://assets.metrolinx.com/image/upload/v1663237565/Documents/Metrolinx/Open-Government-Licence-Ontario-Metrolinx.pdf Open Government Licence – Ontario – Metrolinx].

Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario to deliver mobility solutions for the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA). Metrolinx uses OSM data to populate the addresses in the trip planner system (triplinx). To improve the precision of address ranges information in OSM, Metrolinx design and develop an import strategy to feed missing information from StatCan 92-500-G. The information is provided under Open Data license.
